title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at the College of Saint Benedict, from serene monastic trails to creative makerspaces and art galleries.

cards.title: Hike the Monastic Woods
cards.subtitle: Serene trails behind the monastery
cards.notes: Explore miles of wooded paths including the Trillium Trail. These private monastic grounds are open to the public from dawn to dusk for quiet reflection and nature walks.
cards.short_summary: Quiet wooded hiking trails located on the monastery grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The grounds include serene gardens, outdoor Stations of the Cross, a labyrinth, and three shrines. The grounds are open during the day from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Visit the Monastery - Sisters of St. Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; no pets allowed on monastic trails.

cards.title: Create in the Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Creative lab in Clemens Library
cards.notes: Use 3D printers, sewing machines, and crafting tools for personal or class projects. Staff provide free training and assistance for all skill levels during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative creative lab offering free access to tools and technology.
cards.evidence_claim: The Makerspace is a creative learning lab where CSB and SJU community members can explore ideas, experiment, design, and build... free of charge.

cards.title: Browse the Gorecki Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art exhibitions in the BAC
cards.notes: Visit the Benedicta Arts Center to view rotating exhibitions of professional and student work. The gallery is open to the public and requires no admission fee.
cards.short_summary: A professional exhibition space featuring diverse visual arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery is open from Monday through Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. There is no admission charge.
cards.source_title: Visual Arts | Fine Arts - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10am-4pm during the academic year.

cards.title: Swim at Lake Sagatagan
cards.subtitle: Campus beach and swimming area
cards.notes: Enjoy free swimming and non-motorized watercraft rentals with a student ID. The beach is a popular social spot during the warmer months for Bennies and Johnnies.
cards.short_summary: A private campus beach offering free swimming and boat rentals for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Rentals and swimming are free for College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University students, faculty, staff, and alumni.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 11am-6:30pm during summer; accessible via the Link bus from CSB.

cards.title: Relax by the Gorecki Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Cozy social hub in Gorecki Center
cards.notes: Gather with friends in the comfortable lounge area featuring a large stone fireplace. It is a central meeting spot for students waiting for the inter-campus bus.
cards.short_summary: A warm, central lounge area ideal for socializing and studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The facility includes two lobby areas, a fireplace social area, an outdoor patio space and large windows throughout.
cards.source_title: Gorecki Center | CSB Events and Catering
cards.access_notes: Open during building operating hours; typically late night during the academic term.

cards.title: Workout at the HCC
cards.subtitle: Student fitness and recreation
cards.notes: Access cardio equipment, free weights, and the swimming pool for free with your Bennie card. The center also hosts free group fitness classes like yoga and Pilates.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive fitness facility free for all enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: Each of our campuses has a fitness center as well as a pool... Personal trainers are available to create free individualized training programs.
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for entry; check website for current semester hours.

cards.title: Visit the Monastery Garden
cards.subtitle: Peaceful outdoor courtyard
cards.notes: Walk through the beautifully landscaped gardens and sit by the historic fountain. This quiet outdoor space is perfect for meditation or reading between classes.
cards.short_summary: A historic and tranquil garden space on the monastery grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The grounds include serene gardens, outdoor Stations of the Cross, a labyrinth, and three shrines.
cards.source_title: Monastery Garden and Fountain | CSB Archives
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Study in Clemens Library
cards.subtitle: Collaborative and quiet study zones
cards.notes: Reserve a private study room or find a spot in the open lounges. The library offers free Wi-Fi and public desktop access for research and group projects.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering diverse free study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors have several options for accessing computers... connect to the guest Wi-Fi to access online library content.
cards.access_notes: Open late during academic terms; check library website for specific daily hours.

cards.title: Hang Out on the Mall
cards.subtitle: Central campus green space
cards.notes: The large lawn between academic buildings is the site of free student events, outdoor concerts, and casual frisbee games during the spring and fall.
cards.short_summary: The main outdoor gathering space for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Supported spaces... CSB Mall. CSB Mall Stage. CSB South Lawn.

cards.title: Tour Sacred Heart Chapel
cards.subtitle: Historic monastic architecture
cards.notes: Visit the centerpiece of the monastery to admire the architecture and stained glass. Guided tours are available for free, or you can visit for quiet reflection.
cards.short_summary: A historic chapel offering free tours and a space for quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Guided tours are offered... Tuesday – Friday 10:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m., 1:00 p.m., and 2:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Visit the Monastery - Sisters of St. Benedict
cards.access_notes: Guided tours available Tuesday-Sunday; check website for specific times and blackout dates.
